external.title: Abigail
external.notes: Assaf Ayalon is an Israeli musician/producer; 'Rewire' (2016) is his debut solo album, 12 tracks, blues/rock-folk style influenced by JJ Cale, Knopfler, and Dylan. One search result suggested 'Abigail' may be co-written with Alma Zohar, but this could not be confirmed with high confidence. The album is also licensed through Artlist (royalty-free music library), but no specific confirmed usage (film/show/ad) was found.

external.title: Another Song
external.notes: Saint Anyway is a banjo-bass-guitar folk trio from Duluth, MN (Jamie Kallestad - guitar/vocals, Tony Petersen - banjo/vocals, Dane Levinski - bass), self-described as 'stomp-grass'. 'Another Song' is track 4 on their 2010 album 'Two'. Also available on Jamendo and Artlist as production/library music. Composer/songwriter not independently confirmed, though Ultimate Guitar credits the chord chart to 'Saint Anyway and Jamie Kallestad'.

external.title: Brave Again
external.notes: Israeli-born singer-songwriter's debut album (Aug 2011), folk-rock with soul/blues/country elements; went Gold in Israel. 'Brave Again' was released as one of three singles from the album.

external.title: Brighter Days
external.notes: Track from Logan Pilcher's debut EP 'Ever After Always' (released September 21, 2018), which also includes 'The End', 'Always Mine', and 'Oxygen'. Logan Pilcher is a singer-songwriter from Pensacola, Florida associated with folk/indie folk/folk rock genres. Composer/songwriter credit not confirmed via available sources.

external.title: Dawn Chorus
external.notes: Racoon Racoon is a French chamber-folk duo (Léa & Léonard). 'Dawn Chorus' is the title track of their second EP, released April 13, 2018, written in the Italian Alps and recorded in Belgium with guest musicians Thomas Fiorini (double bass) and Emile Verstraeten (violin/viola/mandolin).

external.title: Please Don't
external.notes: 'Please Don't' is track 5 of 9 on Anthony Lazaro's album 'Strangers in Disguise' (Bramar Records, released March 6, 2020), duration ~3:24. The album is generally classified as pop, not folk, despite the local folder categorization. No composer/songwriter credit was found.

external.title: Summer Snow
external.notes: Artlist.io 소속 로열티프리 트랙. 2014년 6월 8일 발매된 'Summer Snow' 앨범(7곡, 총 23분) 수록곡으로, 같은 앨범에 인스트루멘탈 버전도 포함됨. Spotify/Amazon Music/SoundCloud 등에도 배포됨.

external.title: Susanna
external.notes: John Coggins is an LA-based producer/songwriter/composer who writes production/sync-licensed music; 'Susanna' appears as a folk-genre, male-vocal, acoustic/keys/percussion track on licensing platforms (Audiosocket, Artlist) rather than a mainstream commercial release. No album, release year, or specific media placements ('usedIn') could be confirmed.

external.title: Toasting All My Life
external.notes: Track 8 of 10 on the 'Miami Folk' album by Duce Williams, released November 1, 2014. Album described by the artist as 'my perspective of folk music from a Miami native'. Composer/songwriter credit not independently confirmed.

external.title: Vacations
external.notes: Straight White Teeth is the solo/dreamy alt-pop project of singer-songwriter Patrick McGuire (Denver, CO), formed in 2015 after his band Flashbulb Fires broke up. 'Vacations' appears on the 5-track 'Medicine Sword' EP (Bandcamp/Apple Music). Genre note: press described the artist's overall sound as blending intimate lo-fi folk with gauzy electronics/dreamy indie pop, so 'folk' folder placement fits loosely though the project also leans indie/electronic pop.
